rationale: C206 is a real data error. The flagged stored issuer names include investment terms and acquisition dates, but the raw schedule presents these as separate columns under Portfolio Company, Type of Investment, and Acquisition Date. The cited source rows show clean portfolio-company names in the issuer column, so the extracted issuer_name values are contaminated by adjacent columns.
